BL-681 — Constitutional clause (Article 5): a consolidation never drops a human sentence — binds every future consolidator, not one role's prompt, so it needs human ratification not a pipeline merge
What it solves: Sequenced after BL-680 (`depends_on`) so the clause lands next to the
authority it constrains rather than ahead of it. If BL-680 ships and this is
rejected, the never-drop rule still holds as a role obligation — BL-680
states it in specifier.prompt as well, and its own invariants list carries
it. W…
Approval context: This is a CONSTITUTIONAL amendment, so Article 5.1 requires your explicit ratification — a pipeline merge is not enough, which is exactly why it is split out of BL-680 rather than folded into it.
